headline: Meta platforms Facebook, WhatsApp, and Messenger restored after 1-hour outage
summary: A widespread global outage disrupted services for nearly an hour on Friday, affecting users in the US, Canada, and Asia.
details: Services for Facebook, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram were restored after a widespread outage that lasted nearly an hour on Friday evening.
The disruption began around 7:21 pm Bangladesh time and was reportedly restored by 8:15 pm, affecting users globally.
According to Downdetector, a UK-based monitoring platform, 56 percent of complaints were related to the app, while 26 percent of users had login issues and 11 percent faced website problems.
Users in the US, Canada, Romania, Myanmar, West Asia, and the Philippines reported being automatically signed out or receiving 'unexpected error' messages.
Meta, the parent company of these platforms, has not yet publicly commented on the cause of the outage.
The platforms have experienced several similar outages in recent years, but the full extent of Friday's disruption has not yet been released.

Users in the US, Canada, Romania, Myanmar, West Asia, and the Philippines reported being automatically signed out or receiving 'unexpected error' messages.

Meta, the parent company of these platforms, has not yet publicly commented on the cause of the outage.

headline_marked: Football fever: [[Argentina and Brazil fans hold rallies]] in Barishal
headline: Football fever: Argentina and Brazil fans hold rallies in Barishal
summary: Supporters of the two football giants took to the streets with colorful motorcycle processions, turning the city into a festive hub of sports passion.
details: Supporters of football rivals Argentina and Brazil held separate, colorful motorcycle processions in Barishal on Friday afternoon, turning the city into a festive atmosphere.
The rallies began at Bells Park, where fans wearing jerseys and carrying flags of their respective teams gathered in large numbers.
Argentina supporters, dressed in sky-blue and white, and Brazil supporters, in yellow and green, marched through key city roads including Sadar Road, Chokbazar, and Fazlul Huq Avenue.
Witnesses reported that the processions were filled with slogans, songs, and cheers, with many motorcycles carrying oversized flags and banners of their favorite stars.
Despite the intense rivalry on the pitch, the atmosphere remained friendly and celebratory as fans from both sides exchanged playful banter and slogans at Bells Park.

Local sports organizer Mahbub Morshed (Shamim) noted that such positive events promote harmony and friendship among the youth, marking the first time such a large-scale celebration has been seen in Barishal.
caption:
Argentina vs Brazil: The ultimate rivalry turns Barishal into a festive hub!

Supporters of football rivals Argentina and Brazil held separate, colorful motorcycle processions in Barishal on Friday afternoon, turning the city into a festive atmosphere.

The rallies began at Bells Park, where fans wearing jerseys and carrying flags of their respective teams gathered in large numbers.

Argentina supporters, dressed in sky-blue and white, and Brazil supporters, in yellow and green, marched through key city roads including Sadar Road, Chokbazar, and Fazlul Huq Avenue.

Witnesses reported that the processions were filled with slogans, songs, and cheers, with many motorcycles carrying oversized flags and banners of their favorite stars.

Despite the intense rivalry on the pitch, the atmosphere remained friendly and celebratory as fans from both sides exchanged playful banter and slogans at Bells Park.

Local sports organizer Mahbub Morshed (Shamim) noted that such positive events promote harmony and friendship among the youth, marking the first time such a large-scale celebration has been seen in Barishal.
